$comment: This preset serves as a base for all Windows configurations, defining common settings such as generator, toolchain file, and Vulkan SDK path.
Individual presets for MSVC and Clang inherit from this base preset to avoid duplication of common configuration.
configurePresets.name: windows-base

$comment: This preset is intended for development builds on Windows using the MSVC compiler. It enables version incrementing to test the versioning system, which may be useful for tracking changes during development.
For faster iteration without version incrementing, use the QuickDebug-MSVC preset instead.
configurePresets.name: Debug-MSVC
configurePresets.description: Debug build for Windows using MSVC compiler, with version increment for testing versioning system

$comment: This preset is intended for fast debug builds on Windows using the MSVC compiler, without version incrementing for rapid iteration.
configurePresets.name: QuickDebug-MSVC
configurePresets.description: Fast debug build without version increment for rapid iteration

$comment: This preset is intended for release builds on Windows using the MSVC compiler.
It enables version incrementing to ensure that each release build has a unique version number, which can be important for distribution and tracking.
configurePresets.name: Release-MSVC
configurePresets.description: Release build for Windows using MSVC compiler

Individual presets for Debug and Release configurations inherit from this base preset to avoid duplication of common configuration.
The preset is hidden and only applicable when the host system is Darwin (macOS).
configurePresets.name: mac-base
